nodes.name: Every day at 8am
nodes.notes: 05 Section 5: 'Automated cadence (human approves/sends).' The cadence TIMING isn't given anywhere in the source docs the way the CX cadence's is (05 Section 9 gives CX's 7/30/60/90-day-then-quarterly numbers explicitly) - this workflow's intervals (3/14/45/90 days, then quarterly) are this pass's own reasonable judgment call, not a decided spec, per 06's 'left to Claude Code's judgment' framing for anything not resolved. Flagged in 'Decide due touches' below, not silently presented as brief-given.

nodes.name: Fetch Nurture Opportunities
nodes.notes: Scoped specifically to postLossTrack: 'Nurture' - the one already-documented, decided state this cadence has real data to key off (loss-reason-capture.workflow.json / W4.6 sets it: 'Not Interested'/'Bad Information' opportunities route to Nurture, not Restricted). A broader 'any stalled active lead' nurture concept isn't specified anywhere and would mean inventing a second, undecided trigger rule on top of an already-judgment-call cadence.

nodes.name: Draft nurture message

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-opus-5', max_tokens: 512, system: [{ type: 'text', text: 'You draft short, low-pressure re-engagement messages for leads who went cold or said not-interested a while back. One or two sentences, no guilt, a soft easy-to-ignore next step. DRAFT ONLY for a human rep to review before sending - never implies it has been sent.', cache_control: { type: 'ephemeral' } }], messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Company: ' + $json.companyName + '\nNurture wave: ' + $json.nextWave + '\nDraft a re-engagement touch.' }] }) }}

nodes.notes: Draft only, per the automation risk boundary (05 Section 5 says it outright: 'human approves/sends'). Same Claude call pattern as no-show-reengagement.workflow.json.

nodes.name: Update Opportunity nurture state

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ lastNurtureTouchAt: new Date().toISOString(), nurtureWave: $('Decide due touches').item.json.nextWave, lastNurtureDraftText: $json.draftText }) }}

nodes.notes: Advances the wave/timestamp regardless of whether the rep ever actually sends the draft - a missed/skipped touch still counts as 'touched' for cadence-timing purposes, same as most nurture tools; the draft itself is the record of what WOULD have been sent, stored directly on the Opportunity since there's no per-touch Communications Hub entry yet (W2.5) to log it to instead.

nodes.name: Alert: nurture draft ready

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: 'info', source: 'nurture-cadence', message: 'Nurture draft ready (wave ' + $('Decide due touches').item.json.nextWave + ') for ' + $('Decide due touches').item.json.companyName + '.', linkUrl: ($env.TWENTY_CRM_BASE_URL || '') + '/objects/opportunity/' + $('Decide due touches').item.json.id }) }}

nodes.notes: Routes to #nurture (alertRouting.ts matches 'nurture' in the source string).
